clue.text: Being clear-sighted, doubled old infantry division

explanation.walkthrough: TWENTY twice gives TWENTY-TWENTY, the score on an eye test for normal vision.
explanation.definitionFit: Normal visual acuity is written as a fraction on the optician's chart, so the term describes someone seeing well.
